dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Besides the "taste of happiness," there is also the "taste of sadness."

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: It's a terrible salty taste, which makes you very sad even with just a small bite.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: But Nara seem to like the "taste of sadness." I don't understand this.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Could it be that sharing the "taste of sadness" feels happy, too?
